{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c3bace44.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The colored run at the top defines vertical tracks. Each track bends
    # horizontally at the row of its matching isolated marker; absent markers
    # continue to the bottom edge.
    top_cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value != 0]
    for c in top_cols:
        color = grid[0][c]
        markers = [(r, x) for r in range(1, h) for x in range(w)
                   if grid[r][x] == color]
        if markers:
            r, x = markers[0]
        else:
            r, x = h - 1, c
        for y in range(min(0, r), max(0, r) + 1):
            out[y][c] = color
        step = 1 if x >= c else -1
        for xx in range(c, x + step, step):
            out[r][xx] = color
    return out
"
